name: @thunderclap/template-third-person
description: A copyable third-person action game on @thunderclap/engine: a procedurally generated skinned biped (a glb built at startup, no binary asset) driven by an animation graph, a Follow camera with orbit and zoom, socket cosmetics, foot IK on a heightfield, root-motion attacks, PBR with sun shadows and fog, enemies with name plates and health bars. Copy the folder, rename the package, replace character/ and enemies/.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
